components.observation: The second image retains the clearly garment-owned black rosette at the shoulder, with curled/folded cloth edges and a texture/material reading distinct from the white living flower. Tiny individual stitches remain too fine to claim completely verified.

components.source_concept_unit: low-detail dark intervals remain beside the primary face

Some dark tones remain, but the requested pair of narrow continuous low-detail charcoal physical-background intervals from temple toward jaw is not unambiguously established.

components.source_concept_unit: those intervals separate that face from the existing peripheral ornament
components.expected_visible: The same lateral dark intervals distinguish the main face from the actual peripheral floral decoration; judging emptiness alone cannot prove separation.
components.observation: The face still separates mainly through skin-versus-hair/lace contrast and depth. causal_limit: Cloth floral ornament and living ivory flowers already existed in the independent baseline. Newly explicit material-edge/owner clauses and dark-interval composition do not constitute proof of causal improvement without a baseline render control.
